title: リアルな生き物図鑑
subject_en: Realistic natural-history illustrations of animals in the style of a field guide, each ONE animal centred in its cell, accurate anatomy and natural colours, clean dark outlines and soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: カエル・メダカ・カブトムシなど、図鑑風のリアルな生き物12点です。自由研究や掲示物に使えます。
items: a small orange medaka fish seen from the side
a stag beetle with large mandibles
a red dragonfly with wings spread
a swallowtail butterfly with wings open
a salmon fish from the side
a red crayfish with raised claws
